programme.title: Venezuela, Vignettes of the Orenoco Mission
programme.desc: The Orinoco is one of the most important rivers in South America. It originates in Venezuela and mainly crosses this country with the third largest water flow in the world before reaching the Atlantic in the state of Delta Amacuro. This state is the second least populated in Venezuela, which is easy to understand since most of its more than 40,000 square kilometers is just water and forest. Capuchin missionaries arrived in the early 20th century and established the first missionary center, Mission de Caroní, in Araguaimujo, in 1925. Many of those who reached first died of malaria and yellow fever. Of the missionaries who arrived in the 1950s, few are still alive; however, new missionaries have arrived and others continue to arrive to support the work of evangelism.

programme.title: Mother Cabrini and the Heart of Jesus
programme.desc: The remarkable life journey of Saint Frances Xavier Cabrini, from her premature birth to a lifetime of overcoming odds, as she served humanity through her missionary order dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

programme.title: Daily Mass
programme.desc: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, AL. (LIVE DAILY at 8 am Eastern)

programme.title: The Holy Land Rosary
programme.desc: Fr. Mitch Pacwa leads the Glorious Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the Rosary meditations.

programme.title: The Litany of the Divine Child Jesus

programme.title: EWTN News in Depth

programme.title: Called to Communion With Dr. David Anders

programme.title: Rosary, the-Spiritual Sword of Our Lady
programme.desc: Fr. Donald Calloway looks at the history of the rosary, its victories and its champions, in a presentation that will make you want to unsheath your spiritual sword, and take up the battle against evil.

programme.title: Personalism of John Paul II
programme.desc: Dr. Crosby explains that Personalism examines the subjectivity of persons, or how man experiences himself from within.

programme.title: Saint Kateri Tekakwitha: a Pilgrimage Into Her Heart
programme.desc: Stories of St. Kateri, a miraculous healing and her 2012 canonization---with members of every Indian nation present, are intertwined portraying her as a model of the New Evangelization and a call for all people to treat God’s creation responsibly.

programme.title: All Saints Celebration With Fr. Fox and Friends
programme.desc: Father Robert Fox celebrates the Feast of All Saints Day, by discussing the lives of various saints with children dressed up as their favorite saint.

programme.title: Total Gift, the- a Katherine Drexel Story

programme.title: Chaplet of Adoration and Reparation
programme.desc: A special presentation of the Chaplet of Adoration and Reparation.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!

La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. programme.title: Documentales

programme.title: 13 Razones para amar la vida
programme.desc: No hay amor más grande que el que da la vida por los amigos. Jesús es el amigo por excelencia. Los amigos son benevolentes. Tu amigo te escucha, te regala su tiempo. Cada amigo es la presencia de Cristo. Cuida la amistad. Otra razón para amar al vida.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: De dos en dos
programme.sub-title: San Ignacio y los ejercicios espirituales
programme.desc: De soldado herido a fundador de una orden religiosa que cambió el mundo. Descubre cómo la transformación espiritual de San Ignacio de Loyola dio origen a los Ejercicios Espirituales, una guía profunda para encontrar a Dios en todas las cosas.

programme.title: Lo mejor de la Madre Angélica
programme.desc: Mother Angelica welcomes the president of Christendom College, Dr. Timothy O’Donnell to the show; they discuss the history of the papacy and how it reveals the truth of Jesus’ promise that the gates of hell will never prevail over the Church.

programme.title: La misericordia y el perdón
programme.desc: Cristo es la Cabeza de la Iglesia y todos sus miembros forman parte de ese Cuerpo Místico. Una bella reflexión de cómo ser Iglesia.

programme.title: Kerigma de amor (novena temporada)
programme.sub-title: La segunda venida de Cristo I
programme.desc: El Señor Jesucristo viene en cada Eucaristía, en cada Sacramento, prometió estar con nosotros todos los días, pero además en nuestra profesión de Fe afirmamos que “Está sentado a la derecha del padre y “De nuevo vendrá con Gloria para juzgar a vivos y muertos”.

programme.title: EWTN noticias
programme.desc: Noticiero diario producido exclusivamente para EWTN por la agencia ACI Prensa de Perú. Este programa informativo de media hora de duración se emite los sábados (con repeticiones durante la semana) y aborda noticias católicas del mundo y las actividades de Su Santidad Francisco; incluye también reportajes a destacados católicos de América del Sur y América Central.

programme.title: Beato Anacleto González
programme.sub-title: Beato y patrono de los laicos
programme.desc: Anacleto González fue beatificado el 20 de noviembre de 2005 junto a otros mártires en el estadio de Jalisco, México. El Papa Francisco lo nombró patrono de los laicos de México en 2019, recordando su papel como inspiración para vivir la fe en todos los ámbitos.

programme.title: Cenáculos en familia
programme.sub-title: Reflexiones sobre el padre nuestro en la vida de familia-parte 2
programme.desc: Este capítulo muestra, a la luz de santo Tomás de Aquino, cómo el Padre Nuestro transforma la vida diaria, guiando a cada hogar en fe, amor, perdón y reconciliación con Dios.

programme.title: Hector Valdivielso: el primer santo argentino
programme.desc: Este documental cuenta la historia del primer santo argentino Héctor Valdivielso Sáez quien hizo parte de los ocho católicos mártires de la llamada Revolución de Asturias. El y sus compañeros fueron fusilados sin acusación ni juicio previo.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts open in Jerusalem and discuss the impact of Jesus over the last 2,000 years. He presents the set-up for the arrival of Jesus in the context of Jewish and Roman history. He travel to Nazareth and present the four different Gospel writers, Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John and learns the importance of genealogies as they related to a promised Jewish Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Miracle of the Annunciation
programme.desc: Dave Stotts stays in Nazareth and investigates the Annunciation, where the Angel Gabriel delivered very special news to a virgin girl named Mary. He explore the concepts of angels, miracles, and the importance of the Virgin Birth. He discusses the Roman census and the trip by Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem and examines the importance of Bethlehem in the ancient prophecies about a coming Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem and takes a look at the accounts of Jesus’ birth. He examines the birthplace of Jesus and the accounts of shepherds in the fields nearby. He explores the journey of the "Wise Men" from the East, known as Magi, and the Star of Bethlehem that summoned them. Dave Stotts then investigates the date for Jesus’ birth and the importance of Christmas traditions throughout the centuries.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Grows Up During the Reign of King Herod
programme.desc: Dave Stotts delve into the world of Herod the Great at the time of Jesus’ birth. He examines the “slaughter of the innocents” in Judea. He then visits a number of awesome archaeological sites in Israel built by Herod, including the massive Herodium about seven miles south of Jerusalem. He learn about the escape of Joseph, Mary and Jesus to Egypt until Herod’s death and travels to Jesus’ hometown of Nazareth where he later grew up.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: John the Baptist and the Start of Jesus' Ministry
programme.desc: Dave Stotts starts with the world of Jesus’ youth after the death of Herod the Great. He delves into the Roman occupation and its impact on the Jewish people and learns about John the Baptizer and his ministry of repentance in the wilderness. We experience the baptism of Jesus at the Jordan River and his testing in the Judean desert shortly thereafter.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Returns to Galilee
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the Sea of Galilee where Jesus begins his active ministry and gathers his first disciples Peter, Andrew, James and John.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Turns Water to Wine and Confronts Legalism
programme.desc: Dave Stott visit Chorazin, another location in Jesus’ ministry. He examine Cana and the first miracle performed by Jesus at the wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water to wine, astounding the guests. He follow Jesus to Jerusalem, where Jesus occasionally travelled during special Jewish festivals. He gets angry at the treatment of the temple in Jerusalem and he confronts the religious elites. Jesus meets a Pharisee named Nicodemus and delivers a very special message about eternal life.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Teachings Change Lives
programme.desc: Dave Stotts travel to Samaria and learn about the history of the Samaritans. He learns the story of the Samaritan woman at the well. He again travel to Jerusalem and investigate two pools where Jesus performed special miracles and learns that Jesus brings Living Water. We hear Jesus proclaim himself as the Light of the World.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Sermon on the Mount
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the hillsides of Galilee and hear Jesus deliver the Sermon on the Mount. He walk the Mount of the Beatitudes and explore many of Jesus’ radically new teachings. He learn about salted fish at Magdala and Roman roads at Hippos and delves into Jesus' use of parables, including many of the most famous delivered by Jesus during his ministry.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Travels the Sea of Galilee
programme.desc: Jesus chose twelve apostles from his group of followers. Spend time on the Sea of Galilee and see Jesus calm the waves as he traveled the ancient harbors.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Travel to Caesarea Philippi where Jesus started to wrap-up his public ministry. Also, witness a mountaintop miracle known as the Transfiguration.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Extraordinary Life of Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus spent time with children and confronted a rich young ruler. Visit Bethany and experience the raising of Lazarus from the dead.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Arrives in Jerusalem
programme.desc: Jesus visited Jericho on his final approach to Jerusalem. Experience the accounts of Bartimaeus, the blind beggar, and Zacchaeus, the tax collector.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Jesus and his disciples leave the temple complex and discuss the destruction of the temple. Jesus predicts the terrible events that will take place, including his own betrayal and crucifixion.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Trial of Jesus
programme.desc: See the the events that led up to the trial of Jesus. He prayed in the Garden of Gethsemane, He was betrayed by Judas and arrested by the Jewish authorities.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Crucifixion Of Jesus
programme.desc: Experience the horrible torture of Jesus and his agonizing execution just outside the walls of Jerusalem and examine the nature of crucifixion and the importance of Jesus’ death.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Resurrection of Jesus
programme.desc: Share in the excitement of an empty tomb three days after Jesus’ death, visiting Jerusalem to investigate the accounts of the Resurrection. Explore the Jewish and Roman responses to such a miraculous event.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: We finish with the four faces of the Gospels, the different biographical perspectives on the life of Jesus. We reexamine the Messianic prophecies and visit Qumran in the context of the Dead Sea Scrolls. What is the legacy of Jesus’ followers? What is the summary of the “Good News” of the Gospel accounts? Dave gets personal and ties it all together.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Gospel Shared at Pentecost
programme.desc: In this series, Dave investigates the period of time following Jesus’s resurrection and looks at the courageous lives of the very first Christians.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Church Grows in Jerusalem
programme.desc: In this episode of "Drive Thru History," Dave Stotts helps us witness the growing tension in Jerusalem as the followers of Jesus, known as the Way, face opposition from the religious authorities.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Gospel Spreads to the Gentiles
programme.desc: In the early days of the church, the followers of Jesus face intense persecution in Jerusalem. As they scatter to different regions, the gospel continues to spread. Philip, one of the disciples, goes to Samaria where he preaches and performs miracles, capturing the attention of the people.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Saul of Tarsus and the Road to Damascus
programme.desc: Visit Paul's hometown of Tarsus in present-day Turkey and experience his supernatural encounter with Jesus, which sparked his transformation to Paul the Apostle.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Paul's First Missionary Journey: The Island of Cyprus
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the city of Antakya, the ancient Syrian Antioch, where the early followers of Jesus were first called Christians. He also visits the ancient cities of Salamis and Paphos in the island of Cyprus, where Paul, Barnabas, and John Mark preached the gospel and encountered opposition.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The First Journey Continues: Pamphylia, Galatia and Asia Minor
programme.desc: Dave Stotts continues traveling the route of Paul's first missionary journey, sailing north from Cyprus to the coast of Asia Minor.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Jerusalem Council and the Start of Paul's Second Missionary Journey
programme.desc: After a special meeting of church leaders in Jerusalem let by James, Paul and Silas were off on a second missionary journey.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Second Journey Continues: Philippi and Thessalonica
programme.desc: Dave Stotts takes us on a road trip through present-day Greece, following the footsteps of Paul and his team as they travel from Neapolis to Philippi and then to Thessalonica.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Road Trip to Athens
programme.desc: Paul was chased out of Berea and sailed south to the epic city of Athens. Dave Stotts drives the 300 mile route, visiting historical sites such as Mount Olympus and Thermopylae along the way.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.desc: After escaping the dangerous city of Berea, Paul travels to Athens and then Corinth. In Corinth, he meets Aquila and Priscilla, fellow tentmakers, and they work together.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha meets up with professional Kiteboarder and swimwear designer Sensi Graves to hear what makes Sensi's business specializing in fashion. Sensi Graves is a self-made entrepreneur who started her sustainable swimwear brand - her materials are made from 100% recycled ocean plastics and reclaimed fishing nets. To round out this Oregon adventure and get the whole Hood River experience, Sasha and Sensi decide to trade sports for a day - Sasha tries kiteboarding for the first time, and Sensi tries her hand at climbing.

programme.title: Peak Exclusive Trailer

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Prevent Injuries and Control Breathing CLIMB 25 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help prevent injuries and control your breathing.

programme.title: Training and Cooking at Home

programme.title: 2 Skills to Prevent Multi-pitch Accidents

He demonstrates how to rappel without a belay device using three locking carabiners and a prussik. programme.title: Episode 17, Weekend Whipper: Falling Climber Gets Saved at the Last Second

programme.title: Red Flags: Bolts and Fixed Anchors
programme.desc: Chris Brown, Pro Anchor Maintenance Crew at Salt Lake Climbers Alliance, explains what he looks for when performing maintenance on bolts and fixed anchors. He uses a magnet to test the metal, and looks to see if there is rust, corrosion, bending, or if an anchor is loose. Stainless steel glue-in bolts are the new highest quality standard.

programme.title: The Sport Climbing Fall That Led to a Thumb Amputation
programme.desc: Sam Macllwaine, Associate Editor at Climbing Magazine and Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Outreach & Gear Education at WeighMyRack discuss a climbing accident and how to avoid injuries. Mylee Lorenz, a climber, fell while clipping, and got a rope wrapped around her thumb, resulting in an amputation. Jeff explains scenarios that could have cause this and what to do instead. He says to make sure there isn’t a twist in the rope, not to back clip, and not to grab for a rope when you fall.

programme.title: Episode 18, Weekend Whipper: Your Screams Won’t Save You

Onsight means to send a route on the first try, with no falls. Other terms like flash and trash refer to ways a climber might send a route. He also defines headpoint, meaning to scope a route on top route, greenpoint, brownpoint, and pinkpoint. On location explainer with original b-roll and graphics.

programme.title: Warren Miller's 75 (2024)
programme.desc: Warren Miller is going big for 75 years! Stacked with unbelievable action and unexpected stories, Warren Miller’s 75 will bring fans to powder stashes and chutes around the world, from Canada, Colorado, California, and Utah to Finland, Japan, Austria, and New Jersey. Catch a diverse lineup of snowsports legends, Olympic hopefuls, world champions, X Games stars, and emerging talents, including snowboarders Shaun White, Jeremy Jones, Danny Davis, and Toby Miller, plus skiers Max Hitzig, Lexi duPont, Caite Zeliff, Mark Abma, and Aaron Blunck. With original segments and unique collaborations, this year’s film sets the tone for the next 75 years of ski and snowboard filmmaking. Get ready for the celebration that is 75.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Storm (2002)

Follow along as skiers and riders like Seth Morrison, Toby Dawson, Jeremy Bloom, Tanner Hall, and Glen Plake tackle every condition and obstacle in their way head on in order to ski some of the freshest snow around. Warren Miller takes you on a trip from Idaho, California, and Colorado, all the way to Canada, Austria and even to the distant country of Georgia and along the way proves that a good Storm can happen wherever you’re at.

programme.title: Warren Miller's SNO-CIETY (2025)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s SNO-CIETY is a celebration of the spirit of winter—wherever you ride, and however you connect to the snow and the community around it. From big mountain lines and race gates to urban ski hills and unexpected destinations, come along as we carve turns and find our crew—from California, Colorado, and New Hampshire to Austria, British Columbia, Finland, and Scotland. Drop in with Olympians, urban riders, and local legends on the big screen this fall, including Daron Rahlves, Britta Winans, Judd Henkes, Sarka Panacochova, Breezy Johnson, Chris Rubens, Juho Kilkki, and more.

programme.title: Tien Shan Dream
programme.desc: A team of international skiers embarks on a two-week glacier traverse connecting two remote research stations in Kazakhstan. The Tien Shan's 4000+ meter peaks host an active scientific community, leveraging the rare environmental conditions for groundbreaking research. Established during the Soviet Union's occupation, the high-altitude research stations here are home to some of the longest-standing glacier and cosmic radiation experiments in the world - and are surrounded by deadly alpine terrain.

programme.title: Escape (ESC)
programme.desc: Escape is the second movie coming out of the Colorado based FlowStateCrew. The movie has evolved from showing off what it takes to get out and do what they do, to actually a true Core snowboard movie showcasing some of Colorado’s finest snowboarders stepping away from everyday life to head into the backcountry and ride the way they love most. The film brings together pros like Seth Hill and Chris Corning, rising talents such as Hayden Tyler, and dedicated locals including Corbin Hladick, Nicki Weiss, and Ty Dewitt. Rather than chasing the industry spotlight or relying on snowboarding’s biggest names, Escape turns its focus to the riders who are putting in the time and effort simply because they love it. That shift makes the film more relatable while also proving there’s a whole world of snowboarders outside the contest scene who can ride big lines, go huge off jumps, and still bring the fun that makes a snowboard movie worth watching. Escape was filmed over the course of 40 days, 100% in Colorado. While much of the Core snowboard scene has moved to Utah and Washington, there is still a very active scene in CO and the FlowStateCrew is working hard to bring it together and showcase as many great riders and locations possible. This grit before fame, and get it done mentality has produced some amazing content and were excited to show it off.

programme.title: Escape to the Italian Alps

programme.title: Avalanches and America

programme.title: Ice Jibs and Alaskan Spines

programme.title: Stir Crazy

programme.title: The Off Season
programme.desc: The end of the snow season is in sight and Sean Pettit has a few things he needs to get done before the summer: hit one last filming trip with the K2 team and teach Groovemeister how to backflip.

programme.title: Back At It
programme.desc: Sean Pettit attends the Powder Awards and gears up for the first winter session of the season at Whistler, Canada. Meanwhile, the Groovemeister begins his new career as a restaurant owner.

programme.title: Canadian Backcountry
programme.desc: In British Columbia, Sean Pettit and Mark McMorris ditch their snowmobiles and find backcountry lines via helicopter. Later, a disagreement turns into a truck race between Sean and brother, Callum.

programme.title: Red Bull Cold Rush

programme.title: Pettit Family Vacation
programme.desc: Sean and Callum continue their Euro trip, leaving Switzerland for Italys countryside. En route, the Groovemeister travels in to surprise his boys and the Pettit clan enjoy a few days of fresh powder.

programme.title: Spring is in the Air
programme.desc: Sean, Callum and snowboarders Eric and John Jackson take advantage of Whistlers epic springtime powder. Back in town, the boys tear up a skate park while Groovemeister hops in the wrestling ring.

programme.title: Movie Magic

programme.title: Filming the Lost Rider

programme.title: Warren Miller’s ALL TIME (2023)
programme.desc: Get ready to go deep into the stuff of which snowy dreams are made with Warren Miller’s ALL TIME, from the birth of ski towns to icons and innovators like the original hot doggers—and new footage with Maine’s finest athlete, Donny Pelletier, and the next generation of skiers and riders at Woodward Park City.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Any Snow Any Mountain (1971)
programme.desc: All you need are a pair of skis, snow, and a mountain to journey along in Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain. With an all star cast of skiers including Jim McConkey, Pepi Stiegler, Jon Reveal, Pat Bauman, Roger Staub and many others, Warren Miller takes you on a ski adventure of a lifetime. Follow along as Warren takes you to some of the best powder filled mountains on the planet. From Squaw Valley, up to Whistler B.C., over to Steamboat, and all the way to Japan, see what the original mono-ski looked like, watch as two people try to go down the mountain on the same skis, and witness for yourself the birth of airborn skiing. Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain will prove to you that you don’t need much to get out there and ski.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Snowriders 2 (1997)
programme.desc: Snowriders 2 shows that there's definitely more than one way to get down a mountain. Whether its outpacing an oncoming avalanche, kayaking through the snow at 50 miles per hour, windsurfing on fresh powder in Alaska or heli-skiing with disabled skiers, "Snowriders 2" explodes with excitement as world-class snowriders take to the slopes. Snowriders 2 picks up where last year's "Snowriders" left off, bringing audiences more of the world's top skiers and snowboarders, jaw-dropping action and adventure in exotic locations. And, of course, Warren Miller's dry wit and hauntingly familiar voice. The result: an experience that feels more like a thrill ride than a movie.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Limitless Lines | Warren Miller Vault

programme.title: Warren Miller's Black Diamond Rush (1993)
programme.desc: Come see what it’s like to ski like a real pro and feel the thrill of a Black Diamond Rush with truly extreme skiers like Seth Morrison, Tamara McKinney, Brad Vancour, Chris Tamborini, and loads more. Trek from black diamond run to black diamond run in places like Iceland, Transylvania, Chile, as well as North America and find out what all the buzz is about.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Born To Ski (1991)
programme.desc: We were all born for a reason, and many people have found out that they were "Born to Ski." Join others who were born for the same thing like Bill Heath, Nelson Carmichael, Diana Golden, the Egan brothers, Brad Vancour and plenty more as they do the one thing they were born to do: ski. Travel to places like Canada, Oregon, Chile, France, Japan, even Yugoslavia and find out if skiing is what you were born to do also.

programme.title: Warren Miller's California Skis (1951)
programme.desc: Enjoy the first 10 minutes of the captivating 2nd film of Warren Miller's "1951 California Skis," which takes us on a nostalgic journey back to the early days of skiing culture in Southern California. This time capsule of a film offers a glimpse into the thrilling world of skiing in the 1950s, showcasing the passion and camaraderie of the skiing community. From the breathtaking snowy slopes of the San Bernardino Mountains to the lively après-ski gatherings in cozy lodges, the film captures the essence of this exhilarating sport and its vibrant culture.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Carving Out a Legacy | Warren Miller Vault

programme.title: Warren Miller's Chasing Shadows (2015)
programme.desc: This fall, Warren Miller Entertainment introduces its 66th snowsports film, Chasing Shadows. Watch JT Holmes, Seth Wescott, Caroline Gleich, Steven Nyman and more as they pursue turns on the mountains of our dreams: Chamonix, Alaska’s Chugach, Utah’s Wasatch and the mightiest range of them all: the Himalaya. These athletes are masters in their element, and with every cliff drop, perfect line and knee-deep powder turn, they motivate us. Warren Miller once said, “A pair of skis are the ultimate transportation to freedom,” and this year, we’re chasing storms, snow, lines and the freedom they grant us. Take a glimpse into the world of the U.S. freestyle team and the dynamics of snowsports that live on the fringe, like monoskiing, powsurfing and speed riding. Explore what it means to be inspired, and what it is about exotic locations and snow-covered summits that keep us searching for more. As skiers and snowboarders we chase a feeling, a memory, a storm, a turn — we’ve been chasing it our whole lives and we’ll keep chasing it a lifetime more. Winter starts with Warren Miller.

programme.title: Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case
programme.desc: The cyanide lecture was not over yet for the jury. On the stand, cyanide expert Don Whitworth broke down details about cyanide in its natural and chemical forms. The State claimed that whoever laced Rosemarie ESSA's calcium supplements with deadly amounts of potassium cyanide did it with a bit of sophistication. They claimed it was enough to carry out a murder plot that could've gone undetected by investigators.

programme.title: Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case
programme.desc: The guy who protected Yazeed Essa while he was a wanted man testified.

programme.title: Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case
programme.desc: Prosecutors went deep into how the defendant, Yazeed Essa, fled the country and tried to hide in Lebanon after his wife, Rosemarie, died. On the stand was a man who provided him a furnished apartment, fake IDs, and access to money. Jamal Khalife claimed that the defendant was getting arrogant while he was a fugitive in Lebanon, which Khalife claimed led to him getting captured. He was eventually extradited back to the U.S. to stand trial for the poisoning death of his wife, Rosemarie.

programme.title: Sex, Cyanide and a Doctor on the Run Case
programme.desc: The Defense accused Jamal Khalifa on the stand of making up his story about the defendant confessing to killing his wife, Rosemarie Essa. The reason? So he could get immunity for a 28-count federal indictment he was facing. During cross-examination, Yazeed's defense tried to discredit Khalifa who helped him when he was a fugitive after the death of his wife. Basically, they're just a bunch of actors in plastic costumes, but director Bernard Kowalski (Hot Car Girl, Night of the Blood Beast) made the most of his small budget. programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home. Police tracked the suspects to a nearby park but the criminals were able to escape after a nearly fatal shootout. One year after the original crime, the FBI was called in when new clues emerged regarding the location of the suspects.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: This special episode examines previous cases to learn about the investigative techniques and innovations used by the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a Croatian terrorist group linked to the National Resistance party committed acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the United States. With the help of an informant, the FBI apprehended, arrested and convicted members of the group of crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a rash of home invasions plagued the Detroit area. Each time, masked men disguised as police officers broke in with assault rifles and stole money and jewelry. But when one homeowner shot back, the identity of the intruders was revealed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1985, a Lebanese terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian Flight 405 shortly before take off in Beirut. Several American citizens were on board. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force charged with bringing the terrorist mastermind to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An escapee from Castro's Cuba was the mastermind behind a secret terrorist organization called Omega 7. This group sought to carry out their mission through bombings and assassinations, financing their crimes through extortion and by assisting drug traffickers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Great Philly Mob War

Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Evidence as minute as hairs and fibers can be used to track killers and victims whereabouts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: How murders can be solved even when the body is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The most famous serial killer (Ted Bundy), who may have killed 40 women, was only convicted because of an odontologist's being able to match his teeth with a bite mark on a victim in Florida.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, a maid discovered that a copy machine, placed in a busy Las Vegas casino, was actually a bomb. Agents and bomb experts were called in to disarm the deadly device and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A special task force was formed in the early 1990s to combat the flow of Colombia cocaine into New York ports. As part of an elaborate sting operation, one detective went undercover and infiltrated a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a parole officer was found shot dead in his car, the FBI, DEA and NYPD struggled to contain the mounting violence from drug gangs that continued to escalate. Authorities sought to put two ruthless drug kingpins, Howard Pappy Mason and Lorezno Fat Cat Nichols, behind bars for the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the FBI investigated wide-scale corruption among the detectives of the San Juan, Puerto Rico Police Department. Drug trafficking, extortion, kidnapping and murder-for-hire were among the department's known illicit activities. One detective, Victor Sousse, broke the blue wall of silence and went undercover to help the FBI close the lid on the corrupt cops' activities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When an 80-year-old woman is found barely conscious next to the body of her murdered son in an abandoned van, the FBI was brought in and linked the crime to a teenager and middle-aged man.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When notorious bank robber Byron Chubbuck escaped from New Mexico State Penitentiary in 2000, he almost immediately began stealing again. Though he claimed the stolen loot went to the poor, Chubbuck was no folk hero and the FBI teamed up with U.S. marshals to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On July 4, 1987, seven inmates broke out of a high-security prison in New Mexico. The daring escape was orchestrated by convicted murdered William Wayne Gilbert, who was serving a life sentence. In a dangerous manhunt and race against time, authorities and scientists used the Bureau's crime laboratory to catch these dangerous criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents tracked down a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. As the robberies grew increasingly more violent, authorities launched a complex sting to trap the deadly ring of thieves.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Dartmouth Professors Susanne and Half Zantop are found brutally murdered in their quaint New Hampshire home. Colleagues confirm that the couple was very well liked. With no trace of forced entry, the FBI Behavioral Science Unit investigated the crime and found two teenagers were responsible for the heinous crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A series of bizarre shootings terrorized the small town of East Point, Georgia and left two people dead and two others critically wounded. As the body count climbed, the killer taunted law enforcement with mysterious notes. FBI agents believed the shooter would continue until he was dead or behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands smuggled large amounts of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents targeted the violent group, but its leader remained a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, police, the DEA and the FBI worked together to take down this dangerous drug ring.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home. FBI agents collected fibers from her bedroom and discovered, through the use of laser light sources, a palm print on Polly's bed. After a massive two-month investigation, the FBI arrested Richard Allen Davis. Would the palm prints and fibers match?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1982, a California highway patrol officer pulled a young woman over for speeding. He bullied her into sex and then killed her. He then used a decade of police experience to try to cover up his crime and convince investigators of his innocence.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: The Joy of Painting with Bob Ross

programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Harpers Ferry in West Virginia, to try to save a historic hotel thats desperately in need of help. programme.title: Hotel Hell

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: The Vienna owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach are at their breaking point and have become trapped in their Austrian themed hotel, drowning in debt. programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Cambridge, New York, where ex-military man John Imhof and his wife, Tina, own and run the allegedly haunted Cambridge Hotel. Gordons stay at the hotel is genuinely terrifying, but its not the ghost that keeps him awake, its something far worse.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The River Rock Inn in Milford Pennsylvania, where owner Ken Pisciotta is over his head and drowning in debt. Can Gordon get the River Rock back on track before Ken loses everything?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Juniper Hill Inn in Windsor, VT, a place that looks like a million dollars but smells of raw sewage. He meets the inns wealthy and arrogant owner, Robert Dean II, and uncovers his shocking treatment of his staff. Gordon quickly realizes its going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Its Gordons greatest challenge to date, as he continues to uncover problem after problem at Vermonts Juniper Hill Inn. Abandon ship.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Coeur DAlene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B. To make matters worse, John's wife Tina is ready to run away from the inn and from her buffoon of a husband. Can Gordon get through to John before he destroys both his business and his marriage?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars, an array of diamond rings and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel, and his life. Gordon discovers the extent of Phillips problem when he sees shocking news about the owner splashed all over the front page of the newspaper. Can Gordon save fifty staff jobs and keep the doors to this ninety year old hotel (a place once described as the jewel of Longview) open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegates owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his Butt Hut than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn. Richards sons Duke and Dusty are too busy fighting each other to notice the ever-increasing debt, leaving their mother, Joanna with the entire burden of the inns finances resting on her shoulders. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed? And how will he react to a room full of dancing mushrooms and a dog that swims through the air?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Starkville, Mississippi to try to rescue the failing Hotel Chester. Sukie, his wife, is struggling as the hotel restaurants chef, tackling the role without any culinary experience, and sinking fast. Gordon discovers a family tragedy which explains why this couple have become trapped in their hotel and are drowning in debt. Gordon is desperate to help the two owners escape from their suffering, but is he too late to stop the hotels doors closing for good?

programme.title: Hotel Hell

Morgan, has no hotel manager, so guests have a miserable time in the noisy, neglected, afterthought of a hotel. programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: UFA 345 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London. In this episode, Sean McPike faces Ash Williams in a battle between Birmingham and Wales. Nathan Decastro takes on Tony Shields, Luke Smith gets in the ring with Corey Healey, Liam Rees fights Joe Fitzpatrick in a flyweight title clash and Bradley Scott current cruiser weight champion faces the challenger Kevin Greenwood for the title.

programme.title: UFA 346 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London part 2. Starting off this episode, Ireland's Jonny Lawson battles Brighton's Sonny Smith in the Prize Fighter semi-final bout and Aaron Sinclair and Scott McHugh matchup for the second semi-final bout where the winning fighters will head to Thailand for the final match. Dan Lerwell takes on C.J. Mills in the World Middle Weight Title clash and in the main event Jimmy Sweeney takes on Ionel Levitchi.

programme.title: UFA 378 - Shamrock FC 354
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 354 from Ameristar Casino. Up first is Garren Lucas verus Eric Carrera while Gabe Stein and Joseph Murphy face off. Kody McGehee and Ernest Bolt battle it out for the lightweight title and in the main event Darian Weeks faces Max Choriev in a match between two UFC veterans.

programme.title: UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 1 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. In the first match, Gabe Sestan steps into the cage with Adam Cook followed by Reggie Morris versus Jackson Blankenship. Also on the card Ian Houston takes on Garrenn Lucas in the catchweight division plus Shaine Moffitt versus Kody McGehee in a lightweight bout. In the co-main event, Austin Miller, a kickboxer crosses over to MMA taking on Michael Banks.

programme.title: UFA 475 - Shamrock 370 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 2 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. Starting off this episode Noah Stockdale faces Emmanuel "Primetime" Primer in a kickboxing match. Next up Rohan Aibara steps into the cage with Cameren Harris while Jackson Henson takes on Tyreace Wilbourn in an MMA scrap both fighters making thier professional debut. The main event features undefeated prospect and hometown favorite Jacob Highley taking on Eric Beck one of the best wrestlers in the midwest.

programme.title: UFA 473 - Clan Wars 53 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Padraig Irvine steps into the cage with Sean Gallagher and fan favorite Christopher Boyd squares off against Maksym Danchevesky. In a middleweight bout, Lukas Ptacek and Damian Bobek head to the cage and Rogger Lopez takes on Andrew Barrett.

programme.title: UFA 477 - Clan Wars 53 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. In the first match, Kyle McLaughlin squares off against Gustavo Borges followed by Achmed Bairov who takes on his opponent Omar Al Haj. Next up in the cage, Tristan Barnett faces Peter Halpenny for the Clan Wars 175 pound title. The main event features another title fight as Nate Kelly takes on Ricardo Dearaujo for the belt in the 125 pound division.

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off this episode is Gebril Chaibi versus Miguel Guzman in a flyweight bout followed by a light heavyweight matchup as Blair Sannoh and Emmanueli Adzoh step into the cage. In the main event, Anthony "The Bully" Romero takes on Ricardo Diaz, the Brazillian veteran, for the vacant UNF Bantamweight title.

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In ther first bout, Angel Becerra steps into the cage with undefeated Carson Dohan. In the lightweight division, veteran Darion Champman looks to stop Diego Perez' three bout winning streak. Up next grappler Joe Murphy returns to the cage for a match against boxer Luciano Ramos in a catchweight bout.

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Young prospect Joseph Rodriguez looks to keep his undefeated record intact against Jesse Langarica making his pro debut in a catchweight bout. In the main event, it's a battle for the UNF featherweight title, as UFC veteran Francisco Rivera takes on UFC hopeful Jesse Strader.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: UFA 500 - SFT Combat 63
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT Combat 63 from Sao Paolo, Brazil. Up first, an Xtreme fight in the heavyweight division between Pedro Orlando and Breno Souza and in the flyweight division, Paulo Andre and Bruno Brito step into the cage. In an Xtreme Karate bout, Caique Korchak faces Luiz Soares plus in an MMA catchweight bout, Joab Baianinho and Vitor Showman faceoff. In an Xtreme female matchup, Maju Bertin and Giovanna Bonanome take to the cage in what's expected to be a striking battle.

programme.title: UFA 484 - Dynamite Fighting Show - Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Best of Dynamite Fighting Show part 1 from Romania. In the first bout Damian Johansen from the Netherlands versus Andrei "The Bone Crusher" Varga from Romania face off in the middleweight division. Next up, a Superfight in the Open Division, Spain's Vajtan Shanava faces Romania's Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi. Stepping into the ring next for a boxing match are Gilson DaSilva from Brazil versus Florin Cardos from Romania. Also on this card, two Romanian's battle it out as the younger Sebastian Lutaniuv takes on the more experienced Marius Munteanu with 22 KO's.

programme.title: UFA 485 - Clan Wars 54 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Kevin Walsh steps into the cage with Nate Kelly the defending flyweight champion with the title on the line while Simon Sackey faces Jonny Ward and Aaron Henry takes on Kian McCarton. In the co-main event Mick McBride and Shivraj Patil look to trade punches in the cage.

programme.title: UFA 486 - Clan Wars 54 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up, in a female bout, Alexa Padugan squares off against Gemma Coghill in a rematch. Followed by Billy Sutherland and Jean Bernard Kamali in another rematch in the Clan Wars cage. Next up in the welterweight division, Kyle Paton faces "Lethal" Shea Leathem and in the main event, Bobby Smith and Chris Boyd take to the cage for what's expexted to be an explosive matchup.

programme.title: UFA 488 - Fighters Only 17th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.title: UFA 489 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 1 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. First up is a female matchup in the lightweight division between Karolina Kadzielawa and the more experienced Molly McCulloch. In the next bout with Full Thai Rules, Frank Mulley takes on Shea Patton with an undefeated record. In a welterweight feature fight of the night, "The Boy" Ryan Moore steps into the ring with Saj Imran.

programme.title: UFA 490 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 2 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. Starting off this episode, undefeated Josh Gravesande takes on AJ Durrani in a bantamweight contest. In the next bout, Harry Moore takes on the more experienced Lyes Marinko in the welterweight division. In the main event, Mo Abdurahman takes on lias Krafi for the Featherweight World Title with Full Thai rules and no elbows in this matchup between South Africa and Morocco.

programme.title: UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features a middleweight kickboxing tournament with Darius Olteam versus Edmond Mustafa, Cezar Buzdugan versus Stefan Vranceanu, Andre Varga versus Cristian Neacșu and Laurenti-Gabi Fatiol versus Albert Enache. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: UFA 493 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. Tonight features two heavyweight matchups and the finals of the middleweight tournament. In the first heavyweight bout Petrisor Gananau faces Leonard Ioncila in an Entertainment Boxing Match. Next up is a kickboxing Super Fight in the heavyweight division with Tibor Varga facing undefeated Vasile Corcodel in a Hungary versus Maldova faceoff. In a boxing matchup in the Super Middleweight division, Valentin Cioaca faces Veronel Tarau. The main event is the final of the eight man pyramid tournament to determine the DFS Middleweight Champion.

programme.title: UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.

programme.title: UFA 492 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 3 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a flyweight bout, Artur Arutyunyan faces Josh Pavia and Narek Avagyan steps into the cage with Rodney Kealohi. In the main event, the Rising Stars Lightweight Belt is on the line when the undefeated Izac Enriquez puts his title on the line against Weston Quiroz.

programme.title: UFA 496 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 4
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 4 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. The first bout is in the Featherweight division and places Rafayel Ktikyan against Michael Williams in a battle of the undefeated. Next up, Bryen Dao steps into the cage with Carlos Figueroa for a Featherweight bout. In the main event, the UNF Bantamweight Title is on the line as David Rojas takes on Eduardo Zarate, "The Peruvian Nightmare."
